display_long_description:
🌆 Glitch Glide City: Raise It. Battle It. Take the Crown.

The Champion let the Glitches in.

Glitch City was once a perfect digital world. Now corrupted Glitches crash through its streets, and the Champion sits on top of it all. You're about to raise the DigiBot who'll help take the city back.

[media]


🥚 Hatch Your DigiBot

Pick an egg. Feed it by hand until it hatches, and meet the companion that's yours and yours alone.

🍖 It Becomes What It Eats

Every feed changes it, right in front of you.
Spiky food grows horns, spines and claws.
Zippy food grows wings, fins and antennae.
Rare Shiny food unlocks glowing patterns and rare mutations.
What you hunt decides what it becomes. No two DigiBots are the same.

[media]

🌙 It Grows While You Sleep

Log off, and tomorrow see what it's become. Baby. Kid. Teen. Adult. Then it lays an egg, and the next generation inherits its rarest trait.

⚔️ Hunt the Glitches

Glide, swing and climb across rooftops to reach rare food. Throw your DigiBot's attacks, back it up with your own weapons, and watch it take Glitches on up close.

[media]

🏆 Battle to the Top

Challenge trainers. Beat the Gym Leaders. Earn every badge. Only one player can defeat the Champion and take their place.

🏡 Build Your Park

Your home in the city. Your DigiBot sleeps here, retired DigiBots roam here, and every trophy you win goes on show. Decorate it your way, then visit anyone's Park.

[media]

👥 Free. Social. Always On.

Play free with friends, or meet new digizens in a city that never stops.
